name: Accelbyte Ai Plugins
description: Public AI coding agents, skills, and MCP servers for AccelByte.
longDescription:
Ships **3 skills** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (3): `accelbyte` (Use before working with AccelByte skills or when a request mentions AccelByte, AGS, AMS, Extend, Matchmaking, ADT, IAM,…), `ags` (AccelByte Gaming Services (AGS) — managed game backend), `ags-extend` (AccelByte Extend — custom server-side game logic on AGS)
- **MCP servers** (1): `ags_api`

Installs with `claude plugin install accelbyte-ai-plugins@claude-community` from `AccelByte/ai-plugins`.
